description: Blueberry Ridge is a small farm in 20 Marcus Mitchell Road, MS. It grows Strawberries, Blueberries, Raspberries, Blackberries, and Apples, with seasonal availability through spring, summer, autumn, and winter. The harvest is typically at its peak in summer. Check the website for current hours and availability.
Seasonal availability typically runs from Mar – Jun in this growing zone.
